findings.reason: Confirmed. The audited Construction A layer's third target (targets[2]) says odd m never even, with no correcting note. The standing convention permits any finite coordinate type (AlgebraicCodingTheory README:39-45) and fixes P_m(C)=rho_m^{-1}(C), B_m(x,y)=sum x_i y_i/m (:79-85). With m=3 and empty coordinates there is one word, C={0}, P_3(C)={0}, and its only norm is 0, so the zero-dimensional integral lattice is even. When coordinates are nonempty, m*e_i belongs to every inverse-image lattice because it reduces to zero, and its B_m-norm is m, proving the intended odd-m obstruction. For a coordinate lift a -> a+m*b, the quadratic half-norm changes by a*b+(m*b^2)/2; even m makes this integral, whereas at odd m the lifts 0 and m of the zero residue differ by m/2 modulo Z. Thus the general lift-independent q_m construction needs the even-m hypothesis. The source already states both restrictions at :347-351. Restore them in the audit target, explicitly retain the zero-dimensional exception, and keep the m>=2 and integrality/self-orthogonality context. No source-roadmap rewrite or new gluing theorem is required. Keep absent for this complete target and not built for the layer; its related gluing citations are not evidence that Construction A is implemented. The incorrect target is still present in generated coverage.

Confirmed. The audited DenseGraphLimits Layer 1 second target (targets[1]) and its note omit any positive-host-size assumption. At Tau Ceti f790474, StepGraphon/FiniteGraph/Basic.lean:89 defines finiteGraphGraphon on SimpleGraph (Fin m) without requiring m>0; :116-123 proves the m=0 graphon is constant zero. The actual theorem homDensity_finiteGraphGraphon at :205-207 explicitly takes hm : 0 < m; its proof uses this to reduce the integral to a uniform finite cell sum. Read also HomDensity/Basic.lean:160-171,204-214 (density integral and constant-graphon formula) and HomDensity/Finite.lean:99-100,116-117 (finite count divided by host cardinality to the pattern cardinality). For an edgeless singleton pattern and the empty host, the graphon integrand is the empty product 1, so its density is 1; there is no function to the empty host, so the finite density is 0/0=0 in Lean's total real division. The empty pattern is not a counterexample: its unique empty assignment gives density 1 on both sides. The source roadmap already requires 0<m at README:613 and :819. Add |V(G)|>0 to the audit formula or a directly attached note, record the empty-host/nonempty-edgeless exception, and retain the implemented theorem/citation, tauceti target status and built layer verdict. No new compatibility theorem or roadmap change is needed; the unqualified target is still exported in coverage.

Confirmed. The audited ModularForms Layer 3 fifth target (targets[4]) repeats the explicit fixed-character sum at README:509 with M|N and cond(chi)|M but no M!=N. For every positive level, (M,d)=(N,1) is an allowed term and chi_N=chi, so V_1 contributes the entire character cusp space. Read TauCeti/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Degeneracy.lean:414-429: V_1 is the identity on functions/restriction on forms. The actual oldspace definition in Newforms/Basic.lean:103-107 instead takes d*M|N AND M!=N; its introduction rule :113-119 retains the same restriction and cuspFormsOld_one :148-150 proves the level-one oldspace is bottom. At N=1, k=12 and trivial character, the faulty sum is all S_12(SL2(Z)), which is nonzero by Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/LevelOne/DimensionFormula.lean:160-161 (rank one). The level-one Gamma1 congruences impose no conditions modulo 1, so this is the same ambient group. The preceding roadmap bullet says proper divisors, but that does not repair a displayed formula advertised as exact indexing or the standalone audit target. Add M!=N, equivalently M<N with M|N and N>0, retaining cond(chi)|M, d|N/M, descended characters and all level/character transports. Keep partial for the combined target and partly built for the layer: Newforms/Nebentypus.lean:147-172 proves the relative orthogonal-complement and character decomposition, not the conductor-indexed sum. That file's unproved-roadmap-formula docstring at :35-38 repeats the same omitted restriction; flag it together with README:509 in the maintainer correction note, without changing pinned library code or suggesting the proved definition is wrong. Under PROTOCOL section 15, preserve the existing Tau Ceti owner and record a precise upstream documentation patch, not a replacement oldspace definition or replanned roadmap. Correct the audit source and regenerate coverage through normal integration; the faulty target remains exported.
